title: Anvil Reference Docs for AI Agents
description: Anvil community released reference repository for AI coding agents. GitHub repository anvil-llm-reference provides Anvil-specific context to help agents avoid rediscovery and improve coding accuracy.
author: Anvil Community

title: LLM Agents: The Complete Guide for 2026
description: TrueFoundry published comprehensive guide to LLM agents covering architecture, implementation patterns, and best practices for building agentic AI systems in 2026.
author: TrueFoundry

title: Project Think: Building the Next Generation of AI Agents on Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare introduced Project Think focused on running LLM-generated code safely with Dynamic Workers. Features Agent Readiness score to evaluate site preparedness for AI agents.
author: Cloudflare

title: Governing Coding Agent Sprawl with Unity AI Gateway
description: Databricks released solutions for managing coding agent sprawl through Unity AI Gateway. Addresses governance challenges as enterprises deploy multiple AI coding agents.
author: Databricks

title: A2UI v0.9: The New Standard for Portable, Framework-Agnostic UI
description: Google's A2UI Team introduced Agent SDK and shared web-core library enabling AI agents to drive cross-platform renderers. Advances portable UI for agentic applications.
author: Google A2UI Team

title: Hacker News: Claude Opus 4.7 release discussion
description: Major discussion on Hacker News about Claude Opus 4.7 release with 1884 points and 1366 comments, showing significant community interest in Anthropic's latest model.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Hacker News: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agentic coding release
description: Discussion about Qwen3.6-35B-A3B release with 1209 points and 496 comments. Community excited about open agentic coding model from Alibaba.
author: Hacker News Community

title: ArXiv: The Agentification of Scientific Research
description: Paper exploring how AI agents are transforming scientific research from a physicist's perspective. Discusses implications for automated discovery and human-AI collaboration in research.
author: Xiao-Liang Qi

title: ArXiv: Layered Mutability in Self-Modifying Agents
description: Research on continuity and governance in persistent self-modifying agents. Addresses identity drift, persistent memory, runtime adaptation, and model editing challenges.
author: Krti Tallam

title: ArXiv: Dr.RTL - Autonomous Agentic RTL Optimization
description: Autonomous agent for RTL (Register Transfer Level) optimization through tool-grounded self-improvement. Demonstrates agentic approaches to hardware design optimization.
author: Wenji Fang et al.

title: ArXiv: Autogenesis - A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
description: Research on protocols for self-evolving AI agents that can improve and modify themselves over time without human intervention.
author: Wentao Zhang

title: ArXiv: OpenMobile - Open Mobile Agents Framework
description: Building open mobile agents with task and trajectory synthesis. Addresses challenges in mobile agent development and evaluation.
author: Kanzhi Cheng et al.

title: ArXiv: Discovering Novel LLM Experts via Task-Capability Coevolution
description: ICLR 2026 paper on discovering specialized LLM experts through coevolutionary approaches. Presents method for identifying and leveraging model capabilities.
author: Andrew Dai et al.

title: Factory hits $1.5B valuation to build AI coding for enterprises
description: AI coding startup Factory reaches $1.5B valuation focusing on enterprise AI coding solutions, reflecting continued investor confidence in AI developer tools.
author: Marina Temkin

title: llm-anthropic 0.25 released with Claude Opus 4.7 support
description: New model claude-opus-4.7 supports thinking_effort: xhigh. Added thinking_display and thinking_adaptive boolean options. Increased default max_tokens to maximum allowed for each model. No longer uses obsolete structured-outputs-2025-11-13 beta header.
author: Simon Willison

title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on my laptop drew me a better pelican than Claude Opus 4.7
description: Comparison of two big model releases from the same morning: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from Alibaba and Claude Opus 4.7 from Anthropic, using the pelican riding a bicycle benchmark.
author: Simon Willison

title: datasette.io news preview tool built with Claude
description: Built a custom preview UI using claude.ai and Claude Artifacts for editing news.yaml file. Claude's ability to clone GitHub repos and examine content made this possible.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI takes aim at Anthropic with beefed-up Codex that gives it more power over your desktop
description: OpenAI releases enhanced Codex model with increased desktop control capabilities, directly competing with Anthropic's Claude models in the agentic coding space.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: InsightFinder raises $15M to help companies figure out where AI agents go wrong
description: Startup raises $15M for AI agent monitoring and debugging platform, addressing growing need for tools to understand and fix agent failures in production.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Roblox's AI assistant gets new agentic tools to plan, build, and test games
description: Roblox enhances its AI assistant with agentic capabilities for game development, allowing it to plan, build, and test games autonomously.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Canva's AI assistant can now call various tools to make designs for you
description: Canva enhances its AI assistant with tool-calling capabilities, allowing it to autonomously create designs by invoking various design tools.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Antioch: Simulation startup wants to be the Cursor for physical AI
description: Antioch emerges from stealth with vision to become the Cursor of physical AI, providing simulation and development tools for robotics and embodied AI.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: datasette-export-database 0.3a1 released
description: Plugin upgrade needed after Datasette 1.0a27 no longer sets the ds_csrftoken cookie. Changes how the plugin uses signed URLs.
author: Simon Willison

title: Datasette 1.0a27: CSRF protection modernized and RenameTableEvent added
description: Major changes: Replaced Django-style CSRF tokens with modern browser headers per Filippo Valsorda's research. New RenameTableEvent fires when tables are renamed during SQLite transactions, helping plugins react appropriately.
author: Simon Willison

title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS released with surprising prompting requirements
description: Google released Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, a text-to-speech model directed by prompts. The prompting guide requires elaborate context descriptions including character profiles, scene setting, and director's notes.
author: Simon Willison

title: datasette-ports 0.3: Find all running Datasette instances
description: Tool update now shows working directory derived from each PID and full path to database files, making it easier to track what Datasette instances are running on a laptop.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI updates its Agents SDK to help enterprises build safer, more capable agents
description: OpenAI releases updated Agents SDK with enhanced safety features and capabilities for enterprise agent development, reflecting maturation of agentic AI tooling.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Datasette replaces token-based CSRF with Sec-Fetch-Site header protection
description: Following Filippo Valsorda's research and Go 1.25's implementation, Datasette now uses modern browser headers instead of CSRF tokens. Removes need for hidden form inputs and simplifies API integration.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI announces GPT-5.4-Cyber model and Trusted Access program
description: OpenAI's answer to Claude Mythos: GPT-5.4-Cyber, a cyber-permissive variant for defensive cybersecurity. Also extending Trusted Access for Cyber program with ID verification for reduced friction access.
author: Simon Willison

title: Cybersecurity Looks Like Proof of Work Now
description: UK's AI Safety Institute report on Claude Mythos shows that more tokens spent equals better security results. This creates economic incentive to spend more on security reviews than attackers spend exploiting. Makes open source libraries more valuable as security costs can be shared.
author: Drew Breunig (via Simon Willison)

title: Gitar raises $9M to use agents to secure code
description: Startup emerges from stealth with $9M funding for AI agent-based code security platform, applying agentic AI to vulnerability detection and remediation.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Emergent enters OpenClaw-like AI agent space from India
description: Indian startup Emergent launches in AI agent space, competing with OpenClaw by offering agentic coding capabilities from India perspective.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Steve Yegge vs Google engineers on AI adoption
description: Steve Yegge claims Google has same AI adoption curve as John Deere (20% power users, 20% refusers, 60% using basic tools). Addy Osmani and Demis Hassabis dispute this, noting 40K SWEs use agentic coding weekly with custom tools.
author: Simon Willison

title: Exploring the new servo crate for Rust
description: After Servo v0.1.0 release, investigation shows it's now an embeddable browser engine with clear API. Built servo-shot CLI tool for taking screenshots. Compiling to WebAssembly not feasible due to threads and SpiderMonkey dependency.
author: Simon Willison

title: Bryan Cantrill: LLMs lack the virtue of laziness
description: LLMs don't feel need to optimize for future time and will dump more onto layercake of garbage. Human laziness forces us to develop crisp abstractions because we don't want to waste time on clunky ones.
author: Bryan Cantrill (via Simon Willison)

title: Transcribing audio with Gemma 4 E2B using MLX
description: Recipe for transcribing audio files on macOS using 10.28 GB Gemma 4 E2B model with MLX and mlx-vlm. Uses uv run with specific dependencies and can handle 14 second wav files.
author: Simon Willison

title: QuickJS Python Sandbox Investigation Report
description: Exploration of the quickjs Python package implementing an asyncio-compatible JavaScript sandbox with robust resource controls and seamless exposure of Python functions to JavaScript code.
author: Simon Willison

title: SQLite 3.53.0 released with ALTER TABLE enhancements
description: Major release includes ALTER TABLE can now add/remove NOT NULL and CHECK constraints, new json_array_insert() function, and significant CLI improvements with new Query Results Formatter library.
author: Simon Willison

title: SQLite Query Result Formatter Demo playground
description: Interactive WebAssembly-based demonstration for trying out SQLite query result formatting in 20 different styles including box-drawing tables, CSV, JSON, HTML, and Markdown.
author: Simon Willison
